wind-footsteps: A wind moving through a great garden at evening in slow separate waves, like heavy unhurried footsteps coming closer, each wave of leaves louder and nearer than the last, then sudden total stillness, no voices, no music, no actual footsteps
fruit-tear: Close: a ripe fruit pulled from a branch, the stem snapping, the branch springing back with a rustle of leaves, no voices, no music
leaves-rip: Close: broad leaves ripped hard from a branch, fast tearing and rustling, no voices, no music
fearful-breath: Close: a man breathing fast and shallow in fear while hiding, held breath, a faint heartbeat, no words, no music
serpent-scales: Close: a snake sliding slowly over dry leaves and dust, a soft dry scraping of scales, no hiss, no voices, no music
thorns-burst: Thorny stems cracking up through hard dry soil in time lapse, crackling and splitting earth, dry and harsh, no voices, no music
fire-ignite: A huge blade of fire bursting alight with a deep whoosh and a roar, then a fierce steady roar with crackling, no voices, no music, no explosion debris
footsteps-hard: Two people walking slowly barefoot on hard dry cracked ground, steady steps, a dry wind, no voices, no music
earth-quake: A deep earthquake rumble, the ground shaking, small stones rattling, then stillness, no voices, no music, no buildings collapsing
dawn-birds: A garden at sunrise, clear birdsong, a soft breeze in olive trees, peaceful, no voices, no music
dust-blow: A gust of wind blowing fine dry dust away across bare ground, a soft dry hiss of grains, no voices, no music
